note: A synthetic client (Slice 115 mock). Not a real company.
problem: We run a regional bakery chain with 14 stores. Gross margin fell from 62% to 54% in a year, mostly because flour and butter got more expensive. We need to decide whether to raise prices or cut costs.

answers.common.decision: Whether to raise prices or cut costs; the two owners decide next month.
answers.common.deadline: Before the spring menu, in six weeks.
answers.common.audience: The two owners. Plain language, no jargon.
answers.common.materials: Annual revenue is $9.6 million. Ingredient costs rose 30% year on year. Bread is 45% of sales; pastries are 35% and coffee is 20%. Our prices have not changed in two years.
answers.consulting.current-state: We tried a smaller croissant last autumn and complaints doubled. Waste is about 8% of production. Competitors raised prices by roughly 10% this year.
answers.consulting.success: Get gross margin back to 60% without losing customers.
answers.consulting.constraints: We will not close stores or change suppliers this year.
